part2.question: Describe a time when you saved money to buy something you wanted

segments.v: I want to talk about a time when I saved money to buy earphones. I was in grade 10. I wanted to buy noise-cancelling earphones because my house was noisy and I couldn't study. They cost about three million đồng. It was very expensive for me. My parents said they would give me half the money. So I saved money for the other half. I saved my lucky money from Tết. I stopped buying milk tea every day. I also helped my aunt with her online shop at the weekend. After four months, I had enough money and I bought the earphones. I felt very happy and proud. I use them every day to study. I learned that saving money is not easy but it is very useful.
